Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Frozen Dinner]]: a 1955 Kellogg's Sugar Frosted Flakes magazine advertisement in which Tony the Tiger says "You bet your life they're Gr-r-reat!" to Groucho Marx.

Source: [https://clickamericana.com/topics/food-drink/vintage-1950s-breakfast-cereals Vintage 1950s breakfast cereals], Click Americana. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260521015343/https://clickamericana.com/topics/food-drink/vintage-1950s-breakfast-cereals Internet Archive], 21 May 2026.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a reduced copy (500 pixels wide) of a 1955 Frosted Flakes advertisement that prints the slogan "Gr-r-reat!", the work the card's text refers to. It is used only to identify that work beside the card on [[Jokes]]. It cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free image of it exists.
